sloka: क्षिति क्षमा पुष्कर सम्निभ अक्षी ।या रक्षिता राघव लक्ष्मणाभ्याम् ।सा राक्षसीभिर् विकृत ईक्षणाभिः ।सम्रक्ष्यते सम्प्रति वृक्ष मूले ॥५-१६-२९॥
transliteration: kṣiti kṣamā puṣkara samnibha akṣī ।yā rakṣitā rāghava lakṣmaṇābhyām ।sā rākṣasībhir vikṛta īkṣaṇābhiḥ ।samrakṣyate samprati vṛkṣa mūle ॥5-16-29॥

translations.english: She who has beautiful eyes like lotus petals, was protected by the arms of both Rama and Lakshmna, who is tolerant like the earth and is guarded by the female demons of hideous appearance under a tree.
